answer: The protocol implements a liquidity-sink commitment where quadratic slashing erosion ensures that any Sybil plume of identities triggers an exponential loss of collateral. Capital expenditure scales super-linearly, turning the fable of low-cost attacks into a financial ocean of debt. By mandating that marginal attack costs grow at O(n^2) relative to the extracted value, the economic security threshold remains definitive and impenetrable against any coordinated cluster.
